title: Ambient Coach for Explainable Rollout Decisions and Cost Confidence
creator: Asha Patel
description: Goal: design an 'Ambient Coach' pattern embedded in the Redwood Console to help engineers and PMs make explainable rollout decisions while understanding cost implications. The coach is a lightweight, contextual UI layer that surfaces (1) a confidence meter for a proposed rollout (based on traffic split, metric trends, and historical regressions), (2) a concise explanation of the recommendation (why to increase/decrease traffic, which test signals influenced the suggestion), and (3) an inline cost tradeoff slider that previews estimated cost delta for the next 24/72 hours if the traffic allocation changes. Primary north-star: reduce cognitive load during first-time rollouts and speed up safe rollouts for customers onboarding to Dedicated/Private deployments.
comments: 2026-03-05 - Initial brief: proposed ambient approach to avoid modal interruptions during rollouts. PM interested if coach can be surfaced in both 'Create Rollout' and 'Manage Rollouts' flows. (Asha)

2026-03-07 - Engineering feasibility note: continuous metric sampling for confidence meter requires a lightweight sampling path; suggested back-end flag and event contract to avoid adding latency. (Diego Huerta, Eng)

2026-03-08 - Design review feedback: tighten language on 'confidence' to avoid implying probabilistic guarantees. Replace with 'recommended confidence band' and add a tooltip linking to evals. Also add microcopy variants for enterprise vs. dev teams. (PM: Lara Kim)

2026-03-10 - Prototype update: added cost tradeoff slider with token-estimate preview and quick toggle to show historical cost delta. Shared Figma link with UX research for unmoderated testing. (Riley)

2026-03-11 - Usability plan: recruit 6 engineers across startup and enterprise personas, tasks include interpreting the coach suggestion, adjusting traffic with slider, and reading the explanation card. Metrics: task success, time to decision, and perceived confidence. (Design Research)
2026-03-12 - Pre-launch checklist: copy review pending, telemetry event names reviewed by infra, follow-up ENG ticket for telemetry schema. (Asha)
Ongoing: track NPS for rollout experience in post-release survey and link changes to console-2026.04 release notes.
acceptance_criteria: Interactive Figma prototype with three flows: new rollout, canary adjustment, and rollback helper
Microcopy signed off by PM and Legal for phrasing around confidence and recommendations
Telemetry contract defined: events for coach_impression, coach_help_open, coach_action_apply, coach_slider_change
A/B test plan documented for 'coach visible' vs 'coach collapsed' that measures time-to-decision and rollback rate
Engineering has feasibility sign-off and a minimal API sketch for confidence score (0-100) and cost_delta estimates
Accessibility audit completed for coach component (keyboard nav, aria labels, color contrast)
